summary: NABL is HONEST DISTRESS, not LYING/OBSCURING. The headline drawdown (-56.9%) and reported net loss flip ($31M -> $(17)M) are real and largely driven by amortization/interest from the November 2024 Adlumin acquisition plus growing U.S.-segment unprofitability. However, the principal growth narrative (ARR $539.7M +11.9%, large-customer cohort +13.7%, 103% NRR as a trough) is VERIFIED in the Q1 2026 10-Q: ARR continued sequentially to $548.0M, NRR improved to 106% TTM, and revenue actually accelerated to +13.1% YoY. Adlumin is integrated as a named MDR product line with earn-out payments being made, not impaired. Auditor (PwC, PCAOB 238) is clean with no disagreements; no NT filings, no going-concern, no restatement. Two MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY items: (C4) the 812% ETR optics obscure $118M of cumulative U.S. pre-tax losses 2023-25 with VA tripling from $4.9M to $14.0M, signalling structurally unprofitable U.S. operations; (C5) the Nov 2025 credit amendment took term loans from $336M to $400M specifically to fund Adlumin earn-out — debt-financed M&A in a -57% drawdown environment. Insider activity de minimis ($3.15M in 12 months, no front-running); related-party disclosure (CEO's brother-in-law AI consultant for $0.2M) is voluntarily and properly disclosed. Composite 0.25 indicates a name that is closer to PASS than DECEIT — a stock where the price action reflects honest operational headwinds (U.S. losses, leverage to fund M&A) rather than concealed deterioration. The verifier signal slightly leans against a SHORT thesis (claims are durable) and slightly toward a LONG mean-reversion thesis IF the U.S.-segment burn proves bounded by Adlumin synergies materializing.
